our conversational agent is capable of answering user questions and recommending products without any hand written rules, and without any hand labeled training data for the domain.

our solution has the following advantages: 1) it does not need any hand written rules or labeled training data; 2) it can handle complex conversational scenarios; 3) it can handle different types of user questions, such as product related questions or questions about the agent itself; 4) it can handle product related recommendation scenarios.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is now possible for a business to launch a virtual sales agent with little or no hand written rules and little or no hand labeled training data, and still be effective.
with the help of unsupervised learning techniques, a conversational agent can be trained with a few hundred or even a few tens of data points.
deep learning technologies can be applied to conversational agents in order to reduce the cost and time to launch a conversational agent for any domain.
